text: Without love, it cannot be seen.
When the seagulls cry, none shall be left alive.
There are no miracles. Only the inevitable and the accidental.
A truth without love is nothing but violence.
Do not forget that I am furniture.
Even if you can't believe in witches, at least believe in me.
I'll show you. I'll show you the power of my Endless Magic!
How wonderful it would be, if such things existed.
The truth exists beyond the door.
Good. Very good. It has been so long since anyone has entertained me this much.
Without love, the truth cannot be seen.
I refuse to believe in witches!
